Package it.polimi.ingsw.am54.network.messages

package it.polimi.ingsw.am54.network.messages
Network messages exchanged between client and server, with polymorphic dispatch.

All implement the marker interface ClientMessage. The two sealed sub-hierarchies are:

  • Request (client → server): provides execute(Controller, String, ClientConnection);
  • Update (server → client): provides applyTo(ClientModel).
This way, no switch/instanceof are needed in the network loops.
